text: It is unusual for CA-125 to be normal with these findings, so I need to rule out other causes like benign ovarian tumors or endometrial hyperplasia. Do you have any family history of ovarian, breast, or colon cancer, and have you ever had a pelvic exam or biopsy of the uterus?

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the thickened endometrial stripe and adnexal mass, I must rule out endometrial cancer or a benign ovarian tumor like a fibroma. text: RESULTS: Pelvic Exam: Normal external genitalia, vaginal atrophy, palpable non-tender left adnexal mass, non-enlarged uterus. Endometrial Biopsy: Well-differentiated adenocarcinoma.

text: The biopsy confirms endometrial adenocarcinoma, but the adnexal mass requires further evaluation to determine if it is a primary ovarian tumor or metastatic disease. REQUEST TEST: MRI Pelvis
